found_values.value: Thresholds: INA3221 critical 3.0 A = 30.00 mV on 10 mOhm, 750 counts of 40 uV, each conversion; warning 1.0 A = 10.00 mV, 250 counts, averaged value (AVG 4). INA228 SOVL 30.00 mV, 24,000 counts of 1.25 uV (ADCRANGE 1), both paths. Latching: INA3221 critical and warning transparent (CEN 0, WEN 0, the reset state), because the main coprocessor times the critical line against the blanking and the warning line against 400 ms; INA228 ALERT latched (ALATCH 1), cleared by a DIAG_ALRT read at re-arm only. Blanking: 5 ms, one sample of the tree's 200 Hz sensor: longer than one INA3221 refresh (3 channels, shunt only, CT 100: 3.3 ms typ, 3.63 ms max), shorter than two (6.6 ms typ); no minimum conversion time is stated. Against the port breaker: the blanking acts on 3.0 to 3.96 A only; at 3.96 to 4.84 A the port switch's breaker acts
